meta.name: infographic-item-creator
meta.description: Generate or update infographic Item components for this repo (TypeScript/TSX in src/designs/items). Use when asked to design, implement, or modify data item visuals, layout logic, or registerItem composites.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建或更新信息图组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中设计或修改数据可视化组件。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design or modify data visualization components in a project.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的描述生成或更新信息图数据项的 TypeScript/TSX 组件代码，包括视觉、布局和注册逻辑。
howto.when: 当你要求设计、实现或修改数据项视觉、布局逻辑或注册复合组件时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个信息图数据项，包含图标、标签和数值。
say.note: Claude 会生成对应的组件代码。

say.text: 更新现有数据项的布局，让描述文字在图标下方。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate or update infographic Item component code (TypeScript/TSX) based on your description, including visuals, layout logic, and registration.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to design, implement, or modify data item visuals, layout logic, or registerItem composites.

say_en.text: Create an infographic data item with icon, label, and value.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the component code.

say_en.text: Update the layout of an existing item so description text is below the icon.
say_en.note: Claude will modify the layout logic.
